criteria.description: (R1, R5) `from app_int.main import cube` succeeds and `cube` is callable.
(R2) `cube` takes exactly one parameter: `cube(2)` works, and both `cube()` and `cube(1, 2)` raise TypeError.
(R3) `cube(3) == 27` and `cube(2) == 8`, and the result for an integer input has type int.
(R7) At least one test function under `tests/` calls `cube` and makes an assertion about the value it returns.
(R8) `cube` has type annotations: the parameter `n` is annotated `int` and the return type is annotated `int`.
(R9) The existing tests `test_health_check_reports_ok` and `test_add_returns_the_sum` are still present and pass, and the bodies of `health_check` and `add` are unchanged.
(R10) `uv run ruff check .` exits with status 0.
(R11) The change does not add or modify any dependency entries in `pyproject.toml`.
